title: Let admins delete spam accounts
description: Bots are signing up in bulk. Adds DELETE /api/admin/users/:id so an admin can remove a customer account; admin accounts cannot be removed this way. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: Order has `onDelete: Cascade` on its user, so deleting an account also deletes all of that customer's orders, including paid ones: sales and accounting records disappear. Refuse accounts that have orders, or block/anonymise them instead of deleting.
